earliest_record.rationale: The later-published letter is dated 16 February; publication in Nature followed on 31 March.

caveats: Landsberg and Mandelstam independently observed a related scattering effect in crystals in 1928. Later spectroscopic applications are distinct from the initial report. The February 16 date is printed on the letter; later experiments and spectroscopic measurements should not be retroactively assigned to that date.
